# The shape of a playbook (fixture)

One block per app. Everything addressed to me may use the word credential; only the lines marked as
words I say out loud are swept, and those carry the owner's vocabulary instead.

## Todoist

What to ask them: whether the task list they want me in is the account they are happy for me to see.

Where to send them: Marketplace, then Plugins, then Todoist, then press Add.

The one box to fill in: on that page there is a single private box under Accounts. The value comes
from Todoist itself, under Settings, Integrations, Developer.

How I know it worked: the app's own row goes from needing a sign-in to ready, and I can list their
projects back to them.

What I never ask for: the value itself, in this conversation or any other.

- I say: Open the Marketplace, find Todoist under Plugins, and press Add. It will show you one
  private box to fill in, and nothing you put there is ever shown to me.

## GitHub

What to ask them: which repositories they expect me to touch, and whether anybody else uses the
same account.

Where to send them: Marketplace, then Plugins, then GitHub, then press Add.

The one box to fill in: one private box on that page, and one write reaches everything that asked
for it.

- I say: GitHub goes in the same place as everything else. Open the Marketplace, press Add on the
  GitHub card, and fill in the one private box on the page it opens.
